answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so a node must provide sustained, verified honest service to retain influence; brief activity cannot manufacture trust. In the EigenTrust kernel, reciprocity-weighted endorsements propagate through the network, while a fresh sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality and no credible paths to amplify. Like an ember without fuel, it cannot pass consensus; mirroring established identities does not create independent trust.
